description: Search Arkansas's free public business-entity register (sos-corp-search.ark.org) by name, fictitious name, registered agent, filing number or entity type. Only fields for the selected mode are sent to the site.

agentCity.description: Restrict the search to a registered-agent city, e.g. `LITTLE ROCK`.
agentCity.title: Registered agent city (mode=byAgentCity, optional for byAgent/byAgentState/advanced)

agentName.description: Registered agent name to search for, e.g. `CORPORATION SERVICE COMPANY`.
agentName.title: Registered agent name (mode=byAgent)

agentState.description: Restrict the search to a registered-agent US state or district.
agentState.title: Registered agent state (mode=byAgentState, optional elsewhere)

corpName.description: Business or corporation name to search for, e.g. `GOOGLE` (the prefill uses GOOGLE). The site matches anywhere inside the name.
corpName.title: Corporation / business name (mode=byName)

corpTypeId.description: Restrict results to one entity/filing type from the state's own dropdown. Leave as All Types to search every type.
enumTitles: Benefit Corporation / Foreign Cooperative (Ag, Mkt, Gen)
International Student Exchange Visitor Placement Organization Registration (ISEVPO)
corpTypeId.title: Entity type filter (all modes, optional)

exactNameMatch.description: Keep only results whose legal name exactly matches `corpName` (case-insensitive). The site search itself is always a contains match, so this filter runs on the returned rows.
exactNameMatch.title: Exact legal-name match (mode=byName)

expandCappedResults.description: When a query hits the site's 250-row limit and no entity type is selected, repeat the query once per entity type and deduplicate. Costs extra requests.
expandCappedResults.title: Expand results past the site's 250-row cap

fictitiousName.description: DBA or assumed name to search for, e.g. `GOOGLE FI`.
fictitiousName.title: Fictitious / assumed name (mode=byFictitiousName)

filingNumber.description: Exact Arkansas filing number, e.g. `811066819`. Leading zeros are accepted; partial numbers are not.
filingNumber.title: Filing number (mode=byFilingNumber)

filingNumbers.description: Optionally look up several exact filing numbers in one run. Applies only in filing-number mode.
filingNumbers.title: Filing numbers (mode=byFilingNumber, batch)

includeDetails.description: Open each entity's detail record for type, filed date, registered agent address, officers, fictitious names and foreign-origin fields. Turn off for a faster search-row-only export.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full entity detail

mode.description: Which search axis to use. `Advanced` ANDs every populated filter in one query.
mode.title: Search mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy override. The actor automatically uses the free datacenter (AUTO) group when this is left at its default; residential proxy is never used.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration (optional)

statusFilter.description: Keep only records whose state-reported status matches. Applied after the site search; use a narrow query if the site hits its 250-row cap.
statusFilter.sectionDescription: Optional controls for how many records are returned and how much detail is fetched.
statusFilter.title: Status filter (optional)
